title: Ex-CJ Puno: Senate has ‘sole power’ to interpret impeachment rules
summary: Retired Chief Justice Reynato Puno on Wednesday said the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, has the authority to interpret the constitutional provisions governing impeachment proceedings,…

blocks.text: Retired Chief Justice Reynato Puno on Wednesday said the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, has the authority to interpret the constitutional provisions governing impeachment proceedings, including the rule on the number of votes needed to convict an impeached official.
